summary: IAMGOLD Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing an updated consolidated mineral resource estimate for its Côté Gold mine in Ontario, Canada, prepared under NI 43-101. The update integrates the Côté and Gosselin zones into a single block model with a gold price assumption of $2,500/oz and a 0.25 g/t Au cut-off grade. Measured and indicated resources increased 12% to 20.3 million ounces, with inferred resources up 61% to 3.5 million ounces. This is a routine operational disclosure of mineral resources, not a special situation. No transaction, board recommendation, or deal terms are involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, equivalent to a U.S. current report on Form 8-K for material information.
